title: TextDecoder
notes: One TextDecoder per encoding name is made on first use and reused; each call looks it up and decodes. Bytes are built once per fixture, outside timing. Needs full encoding support in the runtime.
details: One TextDecoder per encoding name is constructed on first use and reused; each call looks it up by name and decodes. The bytes are built once per fixture, outside the measured call. Needs full encoding support in the runtime.
